notes.title: Camp Canyonwood Launch Update (Version 1.0)!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/f4ca39c6d63d92b39d134a7123942a3de1456bc5.png[/img]

After [b]4 years [/b]of development, with a year in Early Access working with the community, we're proud to launch our game child Camp Canyonwood out into the world! We've worked tirelessly with our QA team, our community, and our publisher to fix up and polish Camp Canyonwood into the best little camping sim it can be.

But enough talk, we'll let our changes speak for themselves. Check out the full list below!

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Campers now prioritize putting away a resource immediately after collecting it as long as there is a dedicated Storage for that resource with space available, otherwise they will default to dropping the resource on the ground for the player to collect.
[*] Fixed campers not detecting/using certain Storage items properly.
[*] Campers will no longer autonomously pick flowers or chop trees that are placed by the player, but can still be ordered to do so.
[*] Campers will no longer choose to put tools away to make room in their inventory, with the exception of giving their tools back to the Tool Shed at the end of the summer.
[*] Campers no longer leave camp after their health is reduced to zero three times, they will instead simply reduce their camp rating.
[*] Redesigned/improved Lightbulb (Learning UI) to be more informative - it now additionally displays the current Badge the camper is learning.
[*] Added new tool "Shears" that are now required to be able to Snip Flowers/Plants off the ground. Added Shears to Wick's default shop inventory.
[*] Rewrote/changed all of Pam's donation quests and dialog to be more interesting/varied and encourage more exploration.
[*] Added new custom music track for the northern region of Frontier Valley. 🎵
[*] Fixed keyboard prompts not appearing correctly after mouse input detected.
[*] Fishing Spots in different locations now have varying levels of difficulty. (Forest Fishing Spots are easiest, then Wetlands, then Snowy)
[*] Frogs and Bunnies can now be photographed.
[*] Different sized cabins now all have different sized interiors and bed numbers.
[*] Fixed Hooper not having enough space in his inventory for all his unlockables, resulting in dropping them on the floor and not being available for purchase.
[*] Fixed Fast Travel Bonfire teleport positions not loading properly from a save.
[*] Fixed camper relationships/stats not loading properly from a save.
[*] By default, Player can perform camp activities more easily/with a higher success rate.
[*] Fixed missing starting items for certain camper archetypes.
[*] Fixed being able to pin multiple To-Do List entries at a time.
[*] Fixed To-Do List entries not displaying on game screen when manually pinned.
[*] Shortened time between showing last year's reputation score vs this year's score at Summer End.
[*] Fixed missing gamepad support in Summer End screen.
[*] Added stopgap to prevent accidental purchase of shop item when opening shops on gamepad.
[*] Fixed several instances of overlapping text in menus.
[*] Fixed sprays being edible.
[*] Added in-game notifications for detecting connecting/disconnecting gamepads.
[*] Fixed campers not looking in the direction of their fishing spot while fishing.
[*] Reduced cost of repair for all Bridges and Ramps by 50%
[*] Fixed glitchy-looking fire visuals for Torch item.
[*] Modified several Donation Quests to gift players storage items relevant to the task at hand.
[*] Removed default storage containers (Wood Pile and Mine Cart) from the campgrounds.
[*] Increased sell value of several camper drops (Star Maps, Photographs, Trophies) to $10
[*] Added gamepad shortcut prompts to Trading Menu for clarity on how to split stacks and move between inventories.
[*] Edited and removed several camper traits/likes for better readability, clarity and consistency.
[*] The starter grill at the campgrounds can no longer be destroyed.
[*] Fixed Player being unable to interact with objects after ending the day while holding a camper.
[*] Fixed "Load" button not displaying in Main Menu if Slot 1 is empty.
[*] Improved visual feedback for selecting save slots/knowing which slot is currently selected.
[*] Reduced score threshold for displaying a positive parent review.
[*] Updated credits in main menu.
[*] Fixed player not being able to open inventory while a buildable item is selected.
[*] Text messages are no longer sent during nightmares or the tutorial.
[*] Added gamepad prompt for progressing dialog.
[*] Fixed NPCs not giving you their quest upon talking to them the day of their quest after loading a save.
[*] To-Do Tasks given by NPCs now display the player's current progress towards their goal.
[*] Fixed crash caused by campers attempting to bully a camper that is actively bullying someone.
[*] All Cabin types are now destructable.
[*] Fixed Bears not dealing damage to campers while running.
[*] Changed language/wording to be more specific for several interaction prompts.
[*] Cursor now toggles on/off based on whether gamepad input or mouse input is detected.
[*] Added new visuals for custom Game Cursor.
[*] Fixed campers not being able to be commanded to sleep in their sleeping bags.
[*] Fixed campers not correctly detecting a storage is full before attempting to shove an item inside.
[*] Improved scrolling logic for inventories and menus on gamepad.
[*] Fixed Item Tooltips no longer displaying in Player Inventory Menu.
[*] Added Item Tooltip displays when browsing inventories using a gamepad.
[*] Fixed several instances of To-Do Tasks not checking off properly once their task is completed.
[*] Added new map and title visuals for all Map Signs.
[*] Added new Map Sign to camp entrance to showcase the entire campgrounds.
[*] Added new "Bullying" gameplay tip that shows up the first time you encounter bullying. Also added this tip to the Camp Guide.
[*] Rewrote/edited several gameplay tips to be more clear, helpful, or proactive.
[*] All food items that increase Fun now communicate their purpose more clearly in their shop and item descriptions.
[*] Added on-screen keyboard/gamepad prompts for Bugle, Sprays, and Health items.
[*] Added "Leader Sleeping Bag" item to Catherine's shop.
[*] Fixed visuals for the river near Turnback Bridge.
[*] Loading screen tips are now left aligned for better legibility.
[*] Missing campers no longer appear in the Equip Campers menu.
[*] Added "Missing" display to campers that have gone missing in Day Breakdown menu.
[*] Fixed several major instances of soft locks occurring during the Day End sequence.
[*] Fixed several instances of UI appearing early/overlapping dialog sequences.
[*] Fixed tasks not checking off automatically if a task ends before the To-Do Menu has been opened after a load.
[*] Added a delay between banner logs for finishing a task and gaining a new task.
[*] Fixed To-Do listings not updating their pinned status when a new pinned task is added outside of the menu.
[*] Added safeguards for several spots where players were getting stuck in geometry/falling where they shouldn't.
[*] Increased display size of Hot Bar "Drop" prompt for better legibility.
[*] Fixed redundant notifications displaying when opening To-Do Menu after loading a save.
[*] Fixed fire not animating correctly in several items.
[*] Improved menu navigation on gamepad in Text Message Menu, Collection Menu and Camp Guide (menu item listings now auto-select when navigating).
[*] Fixed incorrect prompt display for menu navigation on gamepad.
[*] "Ghost" Item now displays when moving items in Inventory Menu on gamepad, and follows currently selected slot.
[*] Added new visuals for all Photograph items.
[*] Lake Monster, Mosquito Man and Yeti now drop their respective unique photograph items.
[*] New dialog written for Hooper when selling Cryptid Photographs.
[*] Improved transition between Camper Status Screen and Trading Screen.
[*] Fixed UI overlay displaying while using Trading Screen.
[*] Slightly reduced number of available slots for several Storage Items.
[*] Fixed accidental selection of several non-interactable menu elements on gamepad.
[*] Buildables/Placeables can no longer be placed in the air or over water.
[*] Building Rotation prompt now appears for gamepad users.
[*] Separated "Place" and "Destroy" control prompts to be displayed only in their respective contexts.
[*] Added sound effect for highlighting menu items on gamepad.
[*] Added sound effect for changing values with a slider.
[*] Fixed being able to skip multiple days in a row on gamepad by mashing the confirm button while ending the day.
[*] Collection Menu entries now scale down smaller sized sprites when displaying them.
[*] No longer displaying deprecated skills in Skill or Badge menus (Trash Collecting and Cooking)
[*] Fixed being able to edit non-user-made To-Do listings.
[*] Added paper flip sound effects and navigation sound effects to Collection Menu.
[*] Increased variety/range of beak and feather/skin colors for generated campers.
[*] Leader Menu no longer closes prematurely when attempting to back out of writing a To-Do entry.
[*] Talking to The Jack after the tutorial completes now unlocks his respective Collection Entry.
[*] Fixed being unable to scroll the sell shop on gamepad after selling an item.
[*] Fixed not being able to scroll through camper status listings on gamepad when you have more campers than can be displayed at once.
[*] Modified several buildable item colliders to prevent overlap/placement too close to one another.
[*] Added "First Camper Cabin" to Canyonwood Valley map landmarks. 😢
[*] Slightly increased energy debuff when fishing.
[*] Fixed several Forage items not being tagged/identified by campers properly.
[*] Fixed Trash Can item not being identified by campers properly.
[*] Changed Wick's third donation quest to require Cattails instead of Trash and changed dialog to reflect this.
[*] Removed Fur Bearing Trout from wetlands' fishing loot table.
[*] Removed Cat Fish from puddles' loot table.
[*] Added activity logging back in for Camper Requests.
[*] Fixed campers asking player to clear their inventory while their inventory still has slots available.
[*] Changed color of messages for "roughhousing" versus "bullying" to indicate one is a positive/neutral action while the latter is negative.
[*] Added new gamepad shortcut and prompt for dropping items while managing any inventory.
[*] Added gamepad shortcut for selling a whole stack of items at once.
[*] Fixed not being able to select multiple slots occupied by the same item type in shop interface on gamepad.
[*] Updated/improved camper badge window visuals.
[*] Reduced price of "Strange Bonfire" items from $800 to $250.
[*] Lowered threshold for gaining experience when hiking or exploring.
[*] Fixed soft lock caused by hot switching from gamepad to keyboard while camper equip menu is open.
[*] Added fail safe quest triggers for loaded saves where NPC quests weren't given out properly.
[*] Added failsafe for marking off previously bugged "talk" quests as finished when loading from a save.
[*] Fixed Catherine's Donation Quest/Talk To Quest not firing off properly.
[*] Fixed not being able to scroll to bottom of To-Do List on gamepad.
[*] Added new icon visuals for Bow and Bug Net.
[*] Camera no longer resets the player's desired camera zoom level on its own.
[*] Fixed Screen Resolution options not saving/loading properly.
[*] Fixed currently selected resolution not being displayed properly in dropdown menu.
[*] Added safeguard for older saves to accommodate quest changes.
[*] Added functionality for left/right D-Pad to be able to swap between hot bar slots on gamepad.
[*] Removed deprecated item (Wood Sign) from Wick's unlockables.
[*] Added feedback sounds to main menu and options menu buttons.
[*] Adjusted sidechain compression on the main music channel when stingers play.
[*] Fixed Admin Desk UI gamepad functionality.
[*] Fixed Camper Equip UI not initially displaying back button after opened via the Admin Desk. 
[*] Rephrased/reworded all Badge Level names for clarity.
[*] Rephrased/reworded all Camper Likes for clarity/brevity.
[*] Fixed incorrect shop name displayed for Admin Desk's Shop interface.
[*] Changed default preferences in camper archetypes for more variety in activity preferences.
[/list]

notes.title: The Deseret Update (Version 0.9)
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/k1NSdqA.gif[/img]

Welcome to [b]The Deseret Update![/b] No, we didn't spell "desert" wrong, "deseret" is a Utah word that means "hard worker" or "honey bee," and you better believe we've been as busy as bees this past month on this update! Eh? See what I did there? [i]I also had no idea what to call this update since there's a lot of disparate stuff going into it[/i], so let's just buzz right on in, shall we?

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/f80e64b8a87a3fe99fec9b1a069f9b96aecab4b8.gif[/img]
[b]The Final Biome[/b]

You know that mysterious and enormous desert region that's blocked off by those pesky Government Agents? Well, rumor has it that the Agents will now leave their posts should the camp achieve a five star reputation rating, and you'll gain access to this secretive, closed off desert region full of [b]historical monuments[/b], [b]strange artifacts[/b] and [b]shocking revelations[/b] that may reveal answers to some of the camp's many mysteries. 

You'll have to find out for yourself what this final biome has in store...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/9228484381008c779b5b453c0aa5d2e168a1d96a.gif[/img]
[b]Heat Waves[/b]

Remember, only YOU can prevent forest fires! [b]Heat Waves[/b] now have a 30% chance of happening any given day, and when they occur, make sure you're being careful about how close you're placing fire sources to trees, or you may start a[b] forest fire![/b] Once started, forest fires set off chain reactions that will spread to any nearby trees, and are very frightening for campers to witness. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/0e26d030bf1cbb20cd5a282a79883587f890101c.gif[/img]
[b]Steam Achievements[/b]

You've been asking for them, and now they're finally here! This month we've implemented a whopping [b]44 Steam Achievements[/b] for you cheevo hunters out there, so get hunting! These were a lot of fun to come up with, and I hope they will unlock a need to explore everything Camp Canyonwood has to offer! You can find the full list of achievements here: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1374170/achievements]https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1374170/achievements[/url]

If you have any suggestions for achievements you'd still like to see, let us know!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/8c703ee600b369512cde99fd9a515979ef373425.gif[/img]
[b]Improved/Full Controller Support[/b]

Controller Support is now vastly improved, and Full-er than ever. [b]Gamepad-friendly keyboards[/b] now pop up when entering text in Big Picture Mode, we now display four kinds of [b]new visual gamepad prompts[/b] (Glyphs) based on auto-detected controller types such as Xbox Controllers, Playstation Dualshock Controllers, Nintendo Switch Pro Controllers and Steam Deck!

In addition, we've added a bevvy of other minor improvements and fixes you can find listed more fully in the next section below!

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Quick Inventory Button now available in Camper Status Menu, letting you open any camper's inventory for quick management any time.
[*] Added Ash item for burned trees and overcooked items.
[*] Cookable items can be cooked again to create more types of food (Popcorn, Charred Marshmallows) or will create Ash if overcooked.
[*] New rare items added to Desert Digging Spots (T-Rex Skull, Utahraptor Skull, Mystery Evidence)
[*] New custom visuals designed/implemented for Badges.
[*] Collection Menu now supports gamepad navigation.
[*] Intro "Job Application" sequence now supports gamepad navigation.
[*] Fixed several regressions for menus where gamepad support broke.
[*] Tip Popups now have a dedicated close button on gamepad.
[*] Control prompts added to Clipboard Menu.
[*] Added glyphs for keyboard/mouse control prompts.
[*] Fixed several bugs related to swapping between keyboard and gamepad.
[*] Improved visuals for gamepad-selected menu items to make it more clear/obvious what is selected.
[*] Improved visuals for Collection Entry notifications.
[*] Improved scrolling menus on gamepad.
[*] Fixed double input bug when switching tabs in Clipboard Menu.
[*] Fixed accidental initial purchase/sell when opening a Shop while using a gamepad.
[*] Poison items no longer affect Health or Energy, they now only make campers and the player play their puking animation.
[*] Re-named and doubled Fun buff for being outside the player's party, now called "Free Time."
[*] All Flowers now have a buff radius that increases Fun for campers around them.
[*] Agents now disappear upon reaching a five star reputation rating.
[*] Altered Vernon's five star reputation dialog.
[*] Altered the text of several Museum Displays to include additional story information. (No retcons happening here, no sir)
[*] Altered the text of certain Info Signs to include additional story information or fix incorrect information. 
[*] Changed sound FX for a certain cave encounter. No particular reason, no need to read into it.
[/list]

notes.title: The Wetlands Update (Version 0.5)
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/9woTh8h.gif[/img]

Welcome to the sixth major Camp Canyonwood update! This month, things are getting real wet with rainy days, a huge new wetlands biome to explore, and more!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/7b69cf68669bfee2f60d8e17556551b3b16a6aa1.gif[/img]
[b]New Wetlands Biome[/b]

Our biggest unlockable biome yet. The grassy, puddle and lake-filled wetlands of [b]Beaver Basin[/b] and [b]Claw Marsh[/b] are now available to explore! Go fishing at the abandoned Canoe Docks by Camp Canyonwood's largest body of water, [b]The Sunken Lagoon[/b], and then hunt for insects among the tall grass at [b]Cattail Crossing![/b] When you're done, set up camp by [b]Claw Lake[/b] and watch the beavers work their little tails off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/32d337f7c64d33bec930a952dca2ac834eb38a77.gif[/img]
[b]New Wildlife + Secrets[/b]

With a new biome once again comes new wildlife! New cute-and-busy [b]Beavers[/b] will go looking for trees to chop down, while rumor has it that the [b]Ghosts[/b] of those who drowned in the lakes still haunt these forgotten shores. Was it the [b]Lagoon Monster[/b] that took them under? Or were they dropped into the lake by the gargantuan [b]Mosquito Man[/b] that supposedly flies through the camp looking for lost campers? Neither, of course, because these are just stories!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/5c55c2f0beb4b5950119cc25941b8249150dfd81.gif[/img]
[b]Rainy Days[/b]

Each in-game day, there is now a 30% chance of the day becoming a Rainy Day! On rainy days, as you might expect, it rains throughout the camp! You'll find that the camp staff often has unique dialog on rainy days, so be sure to talk to them to find out how they feel when the clouds begin to weep.

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Re-balanced bug distribution across entire map. Many species of bugs are now exclusive to certain regions, and new spawners have been created to make more concentrated hot-spots for certain species, such as bees, butterflies, and mosquitos.
[*] Grey now has a chance of spawning every night in Jack's Bluff, instead of only on certain nights. UFO Encounters have also gone up in frequency as a result.
[*] New Sound FX created for Yeti and Ghost Vanishing FX.
[*] Ghost Vanishing FX tweaked to be more subtle.
[*] New ambient sounds implemented for the snow biome.
[*] New Evidence has been distributed through the map. Some other pieces of Evidence have been moved.
[*] Certain ghosts have been relocated.
[*] New Collection Entries written for new wildlife, cryptids and ghosts.
[*] New Plant: Cattails can now spawn on muddy terrain.
[*] Puddles are now also Fishing Spots with very small catchable fish.
[*] New "No Swimming" signage has been added throughout the map's various lakes.
[/list]

notes.title: The Alpine Update (Version 0.4)
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OBq9crB.gif[/img]

Welcome to the fifth major Camp Canyonwood update! This month, we've been fleshing out a cold and wild new biome to explore, creating an absolute ton of collectable entries, and getting a bunch of new fixes in! Check out the full details below!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/893fb96f1ce23ab0ec0d779f23eef6e1adc710d9.gif[/img]
[b]New Snowcrest Summit Biome[/b]

The northern snow-capped regions of Camp Canyonwood are now available to explore! Accessed via newly unlockable ramps in Marriage Ridge or Jack's Bluff, you can now venture into the snowy, evergreen wilds of [b]Snowcrest Summit[/b]. Here you can go fish for unique catches in [b]Sister Lake[/b] and [b]Brother Lake[/b], explore the thick forests of the [b]Yeti Backwoods[/b], or gaze into the night sky over in [b]Angel's Clearing[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/b311376af7a1b26fb996528f8b40e6b97b68d6e5.gif[/img]
[b]New Wildlife + Secrets[/b]

With a new biome comes new wildlife and secrets to discover! New adorable [b]Snowshoe Rabbits[/b] are known to populate these colder climates, but is it true about what they say comes stomping around at night in the Yeti Backwoods? What about the rumored Hidden Bunker? Ghosts? Guess you'll have to find out.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/6998a967ccc964787ea4b96e2c9f8b67a21587c5.gif[/img]
[b]Collection Guide[/b]

With all these plants, animals, fish, insects and ghosts to discover in Camp Canyonwood, we thought it was finally time to introduce a [b]Collection Guide [/b]for those who wish to track their various discoveries! Accessed via the Clipboard Menu, you can now read about each new discovery as you find them in the handy Collection Guide sub-menu! 

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Fishing is now performed exclusively on docks. Additional fishing spots have been added to each dock, new docks have been added to the map, and some docks have been resized or extended.
[*] Campers' stats now deplete/increase at roughly half the usual rate. Camper emergencies should happen far less frequently now as a result.
[*] Campers now display a "Heart" and "Broken Heart" above their heads to indicate a change in their relationships with each-other and the player.
[*] Added Fast Travel Bonfires to Disguised Hoopers' shops.
[*] Map Signs updated to reflect new content/landmarks added.
[*] All Bugs have received updated Inventory Icons.
[*] New evidence added, and some older evidence has been relocated.
[*] Relocated certain ghosts.
[*] Created new biome-specific loot tables for Digging Spots, Fishing Spots, etc. Now every biome has unique drops.
[*] Taking an item away while it's cooking no longer makes the smoke and grilling sound play forever.
[*] Fixed some instances of auto-to-dos not checking themselves off correctly.
[*] Water and waterfall visuals overhauled.
[*] Dock and ramp visuals overhauled.
[*] Fixed instance of campers duplicating items when using storage or leaving for the summer.
[*] Fixed Digging Spots disappearing from the map after loading a saved game.
[*] Removed "small" and "large" digging spots for mechanical clarity.
[*] Fixed instance of "black screen" hangup/input freeze after the Nightmare sequence.
[*] Fixed Hooper sometimes not being interactable.
[*] Fixed an instance causing time to stop when a quest was given.
[*] Fixed NPC Shops causing input to freeze after opening.
[*] Fixed a few more instances of OutOfRange errors being thrown by expandable inventories.
[*] Fixed an instance of saved games failing to load in certain circumstances.
[/list]

notes.title: The Controller Update (Version 0.35)
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/HpYa1ec.gif[/img]

Welcome to the fourth major Camp Canyonwood update! This month, we finally buckled down to give y'all something we've been wanting to add for a while - Controller Support! In addition, we've continued fleshing out existing features and adding new ones such as a brand new fast travel option! Check out the full feature list below:

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/8c703ee600b369512cde99fd9a515979ef373425.gif[/img]
[b]Controller Support[/b]

The much-awaited option to use Gamepads is finally here! With the sole exception of typing in your name and custom notes (which should come in due time), [b]Camp Canyonwood is now fully playable with a controller[/b], menus and all! You can even swap between keyboard and controller setups at will! 

This was a hefty feature to implement, and as such we don't expect to have gotten everything perfect out of the gate, so let us know if you run into any issues as you play on your gamepad of choice and we'll be sure to address any kinks as soon as possible! We will continue fleshing out this feature as development continues.

[i]NOTE: Natively supported Gamepad types include - Xbox 360, Xbox One, Sony Dualshock 4, and Nintendo Switch Pro Controller.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/940609776618e57cc4cae768730b2b3f79708ce1.gif[/img]
[b]Fast-Travel Bonfires[/b]

A mysterious new type of Campfire has appeared in Hooper's Shop, known as the [b]Strange Bonfire![/b] When two or more are placed, these mysterious bonfires will allow you to teleport from one to another, letting you supernaturally blip across camp in no time at all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/d08674d7a72bf1a8ede97f7f3b97e98c241cf413.gif[/img]
[b]Functional Watch Towers[/b]

Watch Towers are now no longer just for show! Now, when approaching a Watch Tower you'll be given the option to enter it and from your vantage point, take a look at what each camper is up to at this very moment using swappable Camper Views!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/4576e66b3a6e171fa5f3fef87828e813ac96db6d.gif[/img]
[b]Musical Loudspeakers[/b]

Loudspeakers also received an upgrade this update! Now, when approaching a Loudspeaker you have the option to turn it on and make it play music for the enjoyment of any camper around it. Music will steadily increase campers' Fun when they are within listening radius. 

With this feature comes [b]two brand new original tracks[/b] from our composer David Johnsen!

[i]Additionally, if you hear anything strange playing on the loudspeakers during the day, maybe be sure to keep your campers indoors that night.[/i]

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Removed "Camper Dislikes" in the interest of removing tedium/confusion from the camper management mechanics. While we're sad to see it go, we think this will create a much smoother experience while still retaining incentives for learning a campers' favorite activities.
[*] Many Food items can now restore Fun! Less healthy food such as Marshmallows or Candy won't do much to restore Energy, but they sure can help cheer up a bored Camper!
[*] You may notice new [b]Mysterious Strangers[/b] have appeared across camp! These mustachioed fellows might somewhat resemble the camp's local trailer-dwelling conspiracy theorist [b]Hooper[/b], but they'll assure you that they are [i]completely [/i]different people.
[*] Fixed an issue where players were able to scroll past slot 9 in their tool bar hot selection, throwing out of range errors.
[/list]

notes.title: The Management Update (Version 0.3)
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Le5JV4t.gif[/img]

Welcome to the third major Camp Canyonwood update! This past couple of months we've been taking the time to address the community's most major concerns. Consider this the first major Quality of Life update, if you will. It's our hope that this month's changes will make the game more welcoming for newcomers and veterans alike, and will hopefully reduce a lot of the anti-fun friction! Take a look!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/d63e08abdc8a3434d5e292d01941696b777cadea.gif[/img]
[b]Administration Desk[/b]

Introducing The Administration Desk item! Using state-of-the-art 90s computer technology, this buildable item lets you access several administrative functions! In the Equip Menu you can access your campers' inventories all at once, and in the Structures Shop, you can purchase all large structures for your camp! In future, we hope to add even more useful features to this desk, such as Camp Data screens.

[i]The Administration Desk can be purchased after completing Vernon's third donation quest.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/10fa9b8d8a1d57d83fda13ee0abad0395c853190.gif[/img]
[b]Camper Equip Menu[/b]

At the end of each day, or else anytime via The Administration Desk, you can now access a new menu that allows you to equip all of your campers with anything available in the camp's handy Tool Shed! We hope this will make inventory management easier each day and gives an opportunity to schedule the next day's activities!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/d60f773c2356f2f56d126348a2442ab86c597d0f.gif[/img]
[b]Shops Overhaul[/b]

All Shops now have a brand new look, designed to be easier to navigate and to be more informational! It displays a better, more detailed look at each available item, and includes a list of properties for each item, letting you know its various uses in-game, such as whether it's cookable, edible, buildable, etc! The new UI also displays how many items are left to be unlocked in a given shop!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/211d1567da29eed70a86bf003bed265f09d5c699.gif[/img]
[b]Auto To-Dos[/b]

Your To-Do list just got a lot more automated! Now whenever a staff member or a camper makes a request, a To-Do note is automatically generated and pinned on your screen for your convenience!

[i]NOTE: These types of notes will be checked off automatically once completed.[/i]

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] Implemented extensive rework of the item systems, which will allow for easier item implementation in future updates, and will result in fewer implementation bugs in general!
[*] Implemented extensive rework of the loot and luck systems, which will allow for quicker and easier balancing changes in future!
[*] Implemented extensive rework of the inventory systems, which will allow for new features such as sub-inventories in future!
[*] Doubled the starting inventory size for the player, now with 18 slots available for early game management!
[*] Added many new sound effects to give feedback for many different activities, UI, and animations. (Bridge Repair Sounds, Hit Noises, Rustling, Menu Screen Buttons, Falling Asleep, Alien Chittering, etc)
[*] Reworked tutorial to include new tasks requiring players to learn how to earn badges, introducing the player to each staff member, and learning how to obtain food through Pam.
[*] Added many new tip displays for features such as Badges, Dangerous Wildlife, Texting, Day Planning, and Broken Bridges.
[*] Adjusted text on nearly all tips for clarity and brevity.
[*] Removed floating stat icons from campers.
[*] Reworked/re-balanced camper star scoring system to include bonuses for fulfilling camper requests.
[*] Adjusted base camper score from 3 stars to 1 at the start of each summer.
[*] Removed/moved much of the logging from on-screen notifications to reduce overall notification noise. Many of the logs can still be seen in the raw activity log (lower left corner).
[*] Changed/added new "affirmation logs", which are simply green text notifications to let players know when they've done something good for the camp or the campers.
[*] Fixed many instances of incorrect footstep sounds playing.
[*] Adjusted loot tables for all currently available fishing spots to only include fish appropriate for the current biome.
[*] Fixed loaded items not loading in their texture properly ("pink items" bug)
[*] Added signage to broken ramps and bridges.
[*] Tips and shops now pause the game while displayed.
[/list]

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Howdy Campers,

We’d like to start off by thanking everyone who’s joined us during Early Access. Your support is what keeps us going, and while there are many exciting features on the horizon before our full launch, we couldn’t be more grateful to the folks who have been supporting the game and offering their valuable feedback to help us make Camp Canyonwood the very best it can be. Group hug, anyone?!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/02eac7658b96a0b19617f249a8dc0649002ace89.png[/img]

Now for an FYI regarding the November update! After listening closely to your feedback on Discord, we’ve decided to expand, rework, and refine our update milestones in order to address the content and systems that matter most to you sooner rather than later. That means that there won’t be a November update, but we’ll have a major update in December with the expanded systems you all crave. We’re taking this extra time to prioritize implementing some quality-of-life improvements in order to give you the best experience possible. We hope you’re as excited as we are!

Just to be clear, skipping the November update doesn’t mean there will be less content overall. The opposite is true! We assure you that your patience will be rewarded. We look forward to continuing to hear from you and, together, making Camp Canyonwood the ideal camping life sim. If you haven’t already, please join the [url=https://discord.com/invite/M7nN5ddMwS]Discord[/url] to share your feedback and discuss all things Camp Canyonwood.  For more updates, make sure to follow us on Steam.

Cheers,
The Camp Canyonwood Team

notes.title: The Paranormal Update (Version 0.25)
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ql63kBg.gif[/img]

Welcome to the second of Camp Canyonwood's monthly content updates! This month the campgrounds have just gotten a whole lot spookier. Encounter strange creatures in the woods, hunt ghosts, and decorate your camp to look as spooky as possible!

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/d83a771a614630f1531f858262fde4e2e0edd66a.gif[/img]
[b]Close Encounters[/b]

The night is dark and full of spookiness. This month's update adds more than twice as many [b]Ghosts[/b] across the campgrounds to discover, who will now give a fright to campers who wander too closely. Additionally, rumor has it that [b]Aliens[/b] have taken to scuttling around the Plateau woods on foot on certain nights, but that's totally unsubstantiated.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/5681f0c7cba96b6399f43465d92bcd6fecf91ee6.gif[/img]

[b]New Photography Badge Activities[/b]

Two new Badge Activities in the form of [b]Paranormal Investigation[/b] and [b]Wildlife Photography[/b] have been added this month, allowing any camper or counselor with a [b]Camera[/b] to try their hand at snapping pictures of the campground's supernatural phenomena at night, or just the local wildlife if you're a normal person![i] (Though more dangerous creatures are worth more Badge XP!) [/i]

[i]Camera available from Hooper after unlocking Hooper's Mystery Museum.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/483373cf37db4bb4def12d31ab2a33cd373ef5b6.gif[/img]

[b]Spooky Decorations[/b]

There are 13 new spooky decorations available to customize your camp with! Available from Hooper after unlocking the Mystery Museum, you can now purchase items such as string lights, historical artifacts, spooky signage, cryptid plushies, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/1f0e29fc49fb7815bd722dd9c107501e05b4b4d8.gif[/img]

[b]Day & Night Spawns[/b]

Night activities got a lot more interesting! Only certain things can be found at night now, such as fireflies, moths, bears, and even new [b]natural stargazing spots.[/b] Furthermore, certain wildlife will now be exclusively seen during the day, such as snakes and butterflies. The difference should feel, well, like day and night!

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*] A new Camper Archetype - "Ghost Kid" has been added!
[*] Raccoons will now sometimes rummage through trash cans and empty their contents onto the floor in the process.
[*] New evidence has been hidden on the map (found on the Plateaus).
[*] New dialogue telling you that Hooper plans to open the museum the first time you meet him.
[*] Added a tutorial message for the to-do list, activated the first time you get a Donation Quest.
[*] Raccoons now seen mostly at night, and only rarely during the day near trails.
[*] Campers can now cry (based on needs) and puke (when poisoned).
[*] Poison berries/mushrooms now cause a small health drain over time when eaten.
[*] Slowed down campers' movement speed when they are self assigning leisure time.
[*] Beehives no longer spawn on the ground and instead will spawn randomly in Birch Trees. Beehives now only aggro when the tree is chopped down.
[*] Added 2 potential fixes for campers duplicating tools in the tool shed.
[*] Added many new feedback sound FX for campers and counselor (crying, puking, falling, failing, celebrating)
[*] Improved Fencing Logic, now fences should be able to realign their neighbors' assets when knocked down.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes (Version 0.202)
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed UFO Event not running if loading into expected UFO day.
[*] Campers no longer save some unnecessary info.
[*] Added messaging for campers rescued via Alien Repellent to better communicate the feature.
[*] Fixed player being able to get stuck on ramps and bridges.
[*] Fixed campers not being able to climb certain unlocked ramps or bridges.
[*] Fixed ramps/bridges still allowing terrain population under them.

[/list]

[*] Fixed trash can regression (no longer being used by campers).

notes.title: The Plateau Update (Version 0.2)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/e3e4c288376737e5762961e471e3f5767fbfe337.gif[/img]

Welcome to the first of Camp Canyonwood's monthly content updates! This month we have been hard at work fleshing out three new unlockable regions, a request system for campers, new auto-storage, new foragables, and more!

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/30e754365bd2fdac6103464b3f2ec3746e1e1d1a.gif[/img]
[b]Expandable Campgrounds[/b]

You'll find around the map there are now broken[b] Ramps[/b] and [b]Bridges[/b] leading to new locations. For the right price you can repair these broken down passageways and gain access to one of three brand new locations, [b]Marriage Ridge[/b], [b]Jack's Bluff[/b], and [b]Overlook Island[/b]. These higher elevation areas grant access to scenic views and hiking trails, along with more historical landmarks to uncover!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/f80e044ed8bd779a8217c98971723855be1bc6a3.gif[/img]
[b]Camper Requests[/b]

Campers now have the ability to make requests! Each request they make will last until the end of the day, and if fulfilled, will go towards increasing their camp rating! Requests include things like asking to be given certain tools or food, and if the situation calls for it, for you to help organize their inventories when full!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/7e4a4a02645926a52fbe9daf24cfc29ec1c6a810.gif[/img]
[b]Storage Containers[/b]

To help campers better sort their findings, you can now purchase and build 5 different kinds of Storage Containers! [b]The Fish Cooler[/b], [b]The Wood Pile[/b], [b]The Bug Terrarium[/b], [b]The Forage Basket[/b], and [b]The Mine Cart[/b]! As their names suggest, campers will automatically deposit resources of certain types into their appropriate storage containers should one be nearby. Things are about to get a whole lot more organized!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/10acb9c0b94f06e4727472400e006993f5c5db54.gif[/img]
[b]Mushrooms[/b]

There are now three different kinds of foragable mushrooms that can spawn in forested areas! One poisonous, the others cookable and delicious! [b]Meadow Mushrooms[/b], [b]Morel Mushrooms[/b] and [b]Deathcap Mushrooms[/b] can now be foraged, and will contribute to the Foraging Badge when picked. [i]

(Note: Old saves may not generate mushrooms since the terrain populator only runs once at the start of a game.)[/i]

[h1]Changes and Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Campers now only use the Storage Shed (renamed Tool Shed) for putting their Tools back.
[*] Campers now drop items on the floor if a storage container/trash can is full when they try to use it.
[*] Campers no longer automatically cook fish they catch, preferring instead to store fish in available coolers and will forage if no food is provided. It's up to you to keep dinner on the table! (or floor, rather)
[*] Campers no longer come pre-equipped with tools past the tutorial.
[*] Fixed source of mysterious non interactable weeds appearing near Catherine's cabin.
[*] Fixed campers sometimes walking away while you are talking to them.
[*] Fixed overlapping aggro sound effects for bears and snakes.
[*] Massive performance improvements with terrain population.
[*] Fixed terrain pop-ins happening in view of the player.
[*] Fixed another source of crashes related to pathfinding.
[*] Removed an incomplete camper archetype to fix a number of camper bugs it was causing.
[*] Clamped max campers at 10.
[*] Increased archery target XP gain rate.
[*] Fixed a number of exceptions that were causing hitches and slowdown.
[*] Fixed a number of sources causing AI to stop moving/become stuck while pathfinding.
[*] Fixed layering issue with bug visuals.
[*] Fixed camper scores not saving correctly.
[*] Fixed "invisible trash" loading bug.
[*] Fixed Jack deal text displaying outside the box bounds.
[*] Added new Update section to Main Menu to display the latest update.
[*] Wild Birds can now appear in 4 random colors.
[*] Campers will now collect food from picnic baskets when hungry.
[*] Updated engine to newer version (2021 LTS)
[*] Reduced campers' safety debuffs when outside the counselors' party.
[*] Reduced amount of wood given by tutorial cabin.
[*] Changed wood drops and rock drops to be continuous throughout the process of chopping/mining.
[*] Fixed campers dropping walking sticks on load.
[*] Fixed hiking/exploring progress not being saved.
[*] Fixed Cheesy Chips not being counted as food.
[*] Campers now slightly more prefer to use their tools when self-assigning activities over wandering.
[*] Campers now automatically wake up at 6:30am if not yet awakened.
[*] Added sounds for bears and snakes swinging/attempting to attack.
[*] Added sound for player taking damage.
[/list]

As always, let us know what you think of the new update, and happy camping!

notes.title: Camper Beta Now LIVE & 0.107 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/5962d70b3130bdeac41583eda6d780d7296c78db.png[/img]

Howdy!

We don't like wasting time here, so let's get right to it! We've been collecting your launch day feedback via the Discord and Forums, and today we have pushed out a patch[b] (Version 0.107) [/b]addressing as many of your first day discoveries as we could. Read further below for the full patch notes. But first, let's talk about the exciting new Beta Branch you can jump into as of today!

[h3]New "Camper Requests" Beta! (Version 0.109)[/h3] 

Our lead programmer Jordan has been hard at work on a brand new feature that will allow campers to [b]make requests![/b] We find this adds a ton to the moment-to-moment gameplay, and furthermore gives more direction for players to pursue better camper satisfaction ratings.  

This update also features several quality of life improvements, back-end stability, and some sorely needed counter balancing features in regards to the Storage Shed and campers' tendency to over-gather.

This new feature needs testing before it can be folded in to the main game proper, so we've created a [b]public beta branch[/b] for those of you who would be willing to help test it!

To join the public beta branch and help us test this new feature, navigate to Camp Canyonwood in your Steam Library and [b]Right Click > Properties > Betas > Select "Public Beta Branch"[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38418859/a0e86ee689e06d7697b73d7551b787c544a02e80.gif[/img]

[b]BETA ADVICE: If you do decide to try out the new beta, we recommend you start a new Save Slot if you want to guarantee your previous save will be preserved.[/b]

For those uninterested in testing new waters, we still have fixes for you! Steam should push this update to you automatically.

[h3]Full Patch Notes (Version 0.107)[/h3]
[list]
[*]Rebalanced several donation quests to require fewer materials (Wick, Vernon)
[*]Found and fixed a common source of redundant calculations in terrain. (Better performance!)
[*]Fixed a load timing issue sometimes causing loads not to finish. (If the loading icon doesn't go away, something is amiss!)
[*]Fixed some bad logic causing certain events to run twice.
[*]Cleaned up a few instances of potential memory leaks.
[*]Added more text messages to offer guidance/tips on subsequent years.
[*]Donation quest givers will now text reminders every so often (every 3 minutes) if you haven't yet spoken to them.
[*]Fixed "Zero Stars" bug that incorrectly showcased zero stars when above a certain positive score threshold.
[*]Fixed Jackalope's "Talk" button being disabled at times when it shouldn't be.
[*]Reworded Jackalope's Deals to clarify what's being traded and what's being given.
[*]Rebalanced Pam's donation quests to require more materials.
[*]Fixed a source of campers getting stuck when an activity is unloaded.
[/list]
